text:
[Council File 26-1472]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a request for linkage fee refund from Villard LLC, Robert Longuryan – Refund Claim No. 181410, for the project located at 2333 North Nottingham Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
APPROVE Refund Claim No. 181410 in the amount of $85,488.41 from Villard LLC – Robert Longuryan under Building Permit No. 22010-10000-05163, for the project located at 2333 North Nottingham Avenue, Los Angeles, California 90027.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Department of Building and Safety. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
